gen-gf-marcellus-sc-gf-lexend-zetta: Marcellus SC has gaps at its curve terminals and bodies so tall the capitals barely rise above them. And Lexend Zetta, wide-tracked and drawn like cut ribbon, lets the heading's faint thick-and-thin shading stay the subtler voice.
gen-gf-marcellus-sc-gf-montserrat-altern: Dignified Marcellus SC leads with slightly lighter diagonals and a hint of stroke modulation. Montserrat Alternates follows with zero contrast anywhere, its round letters crowding toward the capital line, so the page moves from carved to chalked.
gen-gf-margarine-gf-glegoo: Big, bouncy lowercase from Margarine, smooth as a plotter line and free of any swelling in the bowls. Glegoo's text serif, with its wide unclosed curves and tall lowercase, keeps a long page easy on the eye.
gen-gf-margarine-gf-graduate: Margarine brings a tall, plotter-smooth lowercase that looks big at any glance. Graduate, a dignified serif with generous white between letters and little gap between capital and lowercase height, gives the pair a bookish, studious quality that never feels rushed.
gen-gf-margarine-gf-hanuman: Hanuman reads as a traditional text serif, high-waisted, with wide-set terminals on the s. Margarine counters with display-sized lowercase and diagonals as heavy as its verticals, and that stark difference in temperament is what defines the pair.
gen-gf-margarine-gf-kadwa: Margarine draws its big lowercase with no shift from heavy to light inside a stroke. Kadwa, a text serif with open-ended curves and a generous x-height, carries a longer passage with a classic, editorial ease.
gen-gf-margarine-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text is a classic serif with a big visible entrance into each curve, its lowercase filling most of the letter height. Margarine's pencil-sketched, unpressed lines make the contrast.
gen-gf-margarine-gf-piazzolla: Margarine's high x-height makes its lowercase look huge. Beside it, Piazzolla's text serif, with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, feels refined and authoritative, while the heading stays loud and round.
gen-gf-margarine-gf-pridi: Pridi is a text serif whose small letters stand proud, nearly capital-sized, with generous space between curve ends and the stem. But Margarine's flat, unmodulated line weight and plotter-smooth lowercase give the pair its strongest hook: two big-lowercase voices, one loud, one polished.
gen-gf-margarine-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum, a classic serif with a wide-open c and a squared-off, woodblock-high x-height, has a dignified, editorial voice. And Margarine, with a single flat line weight in every glyph, is the one that draws the eye in headlines.
